production.note: US model years 2018 to 2019. First: pcna-2018-911-gt2-rs-press-kit calls it "The 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS" and says "It will reach U.S. dealers in early 2018." Last: Edmunds lists a "2019 Porsche 911 GT2 RS" (and a 2018 one, edmunds-2018-911-gt2-rs) and has no 2020 page; stuttcars-911-gt2-rs-991-2 is titled "Porsche 911 GT2 RS (991.2) (2018 - 2019)".

displacementL.note: 3,800 cc. Porsche AG technical data: "Displacement 3,800 cm3". PCNA: "The 3.8 liter engine of the 911 GT2 RS was taken from the 911 Turbo S."

aspiration.note: Press kit: "twin-turbo flat-six"; Porsche AG technical data: "Flat engine with twin turbochargers (VTG turbochargers)"

drivetrain.note: Press kit: all 911 GT2 models have "rear-wheel drive instead of all-wheel drive". Porsche AG technical data: "Drive system Rear-wheel drive".

transmission.note: Porsche AG technical data: "Seven-speed Porsche double-clutch transmission". DCT is Porsche PDK; no manual was offered. PCNA: "The Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) is an innovation rooted in motorsport and is now fitted to the 911 GT2 RS."

powerHp.note: Quote: "Weighing 3,241 pounds with a full tank of fuel, the 700 horsepower twin-turbo flat-six engine propels the two-seater from 0 to 60 mph in 2.7 seconds." Porsche AG technical data porsche-ag-911-gt2-rs-tech-data gives "Max. power output 515 kW (700 hp)"; Porsche Cars North America published 700 hp for the US car and that figure is used as published.

weightLb.note: Standard car (7-speed PDK, without the optional Weissach Package). Quote: "Weighing 3,241 pounds with a full tank of fuel, the 700 horsepower twin-turbo flat-six engine propels the two-seater from 0 to 60 mph in 2.7 seconds." The same press kit says "The optional Weissach Package offers a 40 pound weight saving for the 911 GT2 RS.", so 3,241 lb is the car without it. Matches Porsche AG's "Unladen weight (DIN) 1,470 kg" (porsche-ag-911-gt2-rs-tech-data), which is 3,241 lb.

discrepancies.reason: Edmunds' 2019 spec table prints "690 hp @ 7,000 rpm", while its 2018 table (edmunds-2018-911-gt2-rs) prints "700 hp @ 7,000 rpm" for the same car. No Porsche source opened shows a change in rating; the 690 figure appears to be a database entry error.
discrepancies.resolution: 700 used: Porsche Cars North America's published rating, matched by Porsche AG's technical data.
